props.author: KillaXBT
props.text:
Words genuinely cannot describe how excited I am for the next 2 years.

Swing longs. Continuation longs. Range longs... $BTC

After spending the last 9 months positioned as a bear, I'm more than ready for the other side of the cycle.

An asset can only fall 99.9%.

We're already seeing clear divergence in seller strength.

Sellers are gradually losing momentum. 2 months left.
Chart shows capitulation (realized losses wick), validating thesis that bear cycle is finishing and conviction on 2yr+ upside rally.
